release_readiness_note: Run841 is the latest fully successful GitHub-hosted Windows x64 and Windows Server 2022 lifecycle. The tested source revision 05205ce11a103f1dd36b54aae81ff6d073550f77 includes the run85 technical-step ordering guard, run86/run87 DTC namespace validation and quarantine, run88 OBDb source-count binding, run89 VehiclesDB revision binding, KBA DE stock research-pack integration, and the current pinned research-pack assembly. Desktop/local-core/research tests, ESLint, TypeScript, packaged source-manifest and technical-schema verification passed. It built NSIS x64 installers 0.2.3 and 0.2.4 and passed clean install, external-network-blocked offline launch, SQLite backup/restore, in-place upgrade, integrity and uninstall while preserving the user database. The separate Windows Server 2022 lifecycle also passed. Main has subsequent documentation-only commits; no application-source changes were made after the tested revision. Native Windows 10/11 x64 lifecycle remains skipped because the owner-provided isolated runner gate is disabled. Installers are unsigned because no owner-supplied code-signing certificate is configured. Rights-cleared Russian/EAEU OTTS, exact factory engine/gearbox/ECU applicability and licensed VAG repair content remain release blockers.
